# `len`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the character length of string data or number of bytes of binary data. The length of string data includes the trailing spaces. The length of binary data includes binary zeros.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
len(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- len, example 1
> SELECT len('Spark SQL ');
10
```

```sql
-- len, example 2
> SELECT len(x'537061726b2053514c');
9
```

```sql
-- len, example 3
> SELECT CHAR_LENGTH('Spark SQL ');
10
```

```sql
-- len, example 4
> SELECT CHARACTER_LENGTH('Spark SQL ');
10
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
